text: clean. nice job. now, can you give me a tool for building sky scrapers easier. i have the capability to draw walls in run length but not in height and so doing several layers of height is a timely task also since these will be hollow the could be painted in a 3 dimesion space with 6 faces for skins
resolution: Skyscraper tooling in the iso build pane, two capabilities. (1) TOWER tool — a 🏙 chip in the catalog rail: drag a footprint rectangle and get a HOLLOW shell (perimeter walls stacked N floors high + a flat roof cap) committed as ONE stamp — one undo step, one flat-pad terrain lift, one building under select/move/clone/save-as-prefab. A +/− floors control (1–30, default 8) shows while the tool is armed; a plain click drops a 1×1-cell tower. Walls are oriented front-outward (N/E/S/W) so the shell is a clean 6-face box. (2) FACE PAINTER — with a building selected, a panel offers N/E/S/W/Top/In buttons plus a brush (12 color swatches + a registry-material cycler incl. Materialized customs); each button paints that world-facing side of the selection in one click, using geometric exterior detection so hand-built shells paint correctly too. Backed by a new worldStream event pieceSkinSet (mirrors pieceEditSet; merges slots, keeps the piece id stable so the selection survives painting face after face), validated at the materializer and map-scoped in both commit paths. placed.test.ts 47/47 incl. a new pieceSkinSet behavior test; rjit game verify GREEN 72/72; bundle clean. Commit 15d8bec33 (note: includes a co-editing lane's completed prefab-skin-refresh hunks in stream.ts/placed.test.ts that rode the shared files, per the land-it ruling).
